paragraphs.text: Thus we see that the thing which neither the king nor the princes nor the people dared to undertake against the prophet of God, this priest as a chief instrument of Satan first attempted, read Jer 18:18.

paragraphs.text: Who have allowed themselves to be abused by your false prophecies.

paragraphs.text: In this appears the impatiency which often overcomes the servants of God when they do not see their labours profit, and also feel their own weakness. See Geneva "Jer 15:18"
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: You thrust me forth to this work against my will.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: He shows that he did his office in that he reproved the people of their vices and threatened them with God's judgments: but because he was derided and persecuted for this, he was discouraged, and would have stopped preaching, except that God's spirit forced him to it.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Thus the enemies conferred together to know what they had heard him say, that they might accuse him of it, read Isa 29:21.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Here he shows how his faith strove against temptation and sought the Lord for strength.

paragraphs.text: How the children of God are overcome in this battle of the flesh and the Spirit, and into what inconveniences they fall till God raises them up again: read Job 3:1, Jer 15:10.
